prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on the recent price trend: the share price is 6.5% higher than a year ago. Also in its favour: over the past year the share did 8.7 percentage points better than the Nifty 50; the share price is close to its 52-week high; and profit grew 23% in the last financial year. Other areas on this side: growth, the balance sheet, cash flow and the balance sheet.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on price behaviour: the 3-year maximum drawdown was -62.9%, a deep fall. Also against it: one-year volatility is 57.2%, high; risk scores only 4 of 100 against the comparison pool; and quality scores only 28 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: risk, the quality of the business, cash flow and the balance sheet.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 9 points in favour and 5 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 37 of 100. The side that carries most weight is the recent price trend. That gives an educational rating of Hold with high confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
